steps.action: One complete right-handed overhand baseball pitch thrown toward the LEFT edge of the frame, in this order: from the set position she rocks her weight back onto her right leg, turns her body sideways and lifts her left knee high toward her chest; then she drives forward in a long stride to the left and plants her left foot far ahead on the same ground line; her hips and torso rotate hard to the left while her right throwing arm whips up over the top from behind her head; she releases the ball far out in front of her toward the left; she finishes with a strong follow-through, bending forward as the throwing arm swings down across her body past her left knee and her right leg lifts behind her. The ball is not drawn after it leaves her hand. Whole body stays inside the frame.
